අ ෙශෂ EXTRAORDINARY The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

PART III - LANDS FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 176 (Monaragala) Whereas a settlement notice under Section 4 of the Land Settlement Ordinance was duly published in the Gazette No. 176 of 15th Janu-ary 1982, and as otherwise required by the said Section, in respect of the lands situated in Main area in Buttala Korale in Wellawaya D.R.O.’s Division (Now Buttala Divisional Secretary’s Division) of the Monaragala District in Uva Province and described as Lot no. 738 in Block Survey Topo Plan No. 76 (Uva) (Vide Settlement Notice No. 5067 (Monaragala)). And whereas all claims received in pursuance of the said notice have been duly dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the said Ordinance: I, the undersigned, in pursuance of the powers conferred on me by Section 5(5) of the said Ordinance do hereby make order that the lands or portions thereof be settled as specified in the Schedule to this order. D.M.M. DISSANAYAKA, Assistant Settlement Officer Commissioner of - Land Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, Battaramulla 04th October, 2016.
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
